iterations.arithmetic: 10 - 0 (no beat missing) - 0 (no beat out of order) = 10

beats.quote: Nell Harker stood four steps below with her boots in the standing water and did not come up.
She wiped the nib on the inside of her left cuff, which was black to the elbow and had been for years, and wrote: 2.41, east by north, Sweet Providence, smack.
He took the last quarter's returns out and went down the unmatched names at half voice
Enter her a third time and she goes to the Drowned Page, and I will countersign her there myself, and the name is closed.
